flow-music.note: Local server with no pip dependencies: JSON-RPC over stdio using the stdlib. Requires a www.flowmusic.app session in ~/.config/flowmusic/cookies.json, at the project root as www.flowmusic.app.cookies.json, or in FLOWMUSIC_COOKIES. FLOWMUSIC_MIN_INTERVAL sets the floor of seconds between requests: do not lower it below 2.5 without reason.
